SELECT c.contract_id, pa.application_id, p.project_id,
p.title AS project_title, cu.name AS client_name,
DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(c.completed_at, c.contract_end_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS completed_date,
c.total_budget, c.client_rating, c.client_experience
FROM contracts c JOIN project_applications pa ON pa.application_id = c.contract_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = pa.project_id JOIN users cu ON cu.user_id = p.client_id
WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{freelancerId} AND c.contract_status = 'COMPLETED'
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.completed_at, c.contract_end_date) DESC

SELECT s.stack_id AS stackId, s.stack_name AS stackName, pfs.is_primary AS isPrimary FROM project_freelancer_stacks pfs JOIN stacks s ON s.stack_id = pfs.stack_id WHERE pfs.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY pfs.is_primary DESC, s.stack_name ASC
